name: with dict unpack
template: {% with a, b = 1, 2 %}{{ a }}{{ b }}{% endwith %}

name: for over none
template: {% for x in none %}x{% else %}e{% endfor %}

name: elif after else error
template: {% if false %}a{% else %}b{% elif true %}c{% endif %}

name: range equal bounds
template: {% for i in range(2, 2) %}x{% else %}e{% endfor %}

name: range reverse
template: {% for i in range(3, 0) %}{{ i }}{% endfor %}|

name: cycler reset then current
template: {% set c = cycler('a', 'b') %}{{ c.next() }}{{ c.reset() }}{{ c.current }}

name: namespace bool set
template: {% set ns = namespace() %}{% set ns.flag = true %}{{ ns.flag }}

name: namespace with context
template: {% set ns = namespace(x=1) %}{% with y = 2 %}{% set ns.x = y %}{% endwith %}{{ ns.x }}
